products.description_en: By legal binding, all vehicles circulating in Lao PDR must have insurance to cover their victims in case of road accidents. Whether you are the owner/driver of a vehicle such as tuk-tuk, a motorbike, a car, a pick-up or a truck with a very experienced and cautious drive, you may be involved in a traffic accident and there may be victims of bodily injuries or loss of life

content.html:
Protect yourself against finanical lost

Protect yourself against financial lost

Third Party Liability Motor Insurance (TPL)

By legal binding, all vehicles circulating in Lao PDR must have insurance to cover their victims in case of road accidents. Whether you are the owner/driver of a vehicle such as tuk-tuk, a motorbike, a car, a pick-up or a truck with a very experienced and cautious drive, you may be involved in a traffic accident and there may be victims of bodily injuries or loss of life

Assurances General Laos Third Party Liability Motor Insurance cover your expense that may occur in the event of experiencing car accidents in addition to any resulting property damages or physical injuries or death.
Assurances General Laos Third Party Liability Motor Insurance will reimburse to the other parties as follows:

  • Medical and hospital costs in case of injury
  • Permanent disability
  • Death compensation to victim's family
  • Damage to property (e.g. vehicle, object, animal and/or transported goods)

Important note that the Third-Party Liability Insurance will only cover the damages obtained by a third party resulting from an accident in which you are responsible but not your vehicle.

Details of Coverage

products.description_en: Assurances General Laos Health Insurance provides you with sufficient cover for minor health problems up to serious illness, and including hospitalization and doctor visit.

content.html:
You will be reimbursed for all related health expenses

Assurances General Laos Health Insurance provides you with sufficient cover for minor health problems up to serious illness, and including hospitalization and doctor visit.

Health Insurance provides reimbursement of your medical and hospital expenses. In the event of illness or hospitalization, some expenses may carry to you. With Assurances General Laos Health Insurance, you will be reimbursed for all related expenses as follows:

  • Health Insurance
  • Room and meal fees
  • Medicines and drugs
  • Intensive Care Unit (ICU) service
  • Surgical/operational fees
  • Anesthetics
  • Medical fees for accident injuries

Out Patient Department (OPD)

Health Insurance also provides Out Patient (OPD) Cover for the case that you need to see a doctor for a minor illness with no need of hospitalization with maximum of 30 visits per year.

Health Insurance for Group Coverage

Health Insurance provide a health insurance group coverage for a corporate company with an efficient and smart solution to cover their employee medical expense with many benefits.

  • Streamline and Save in the total medical expense for your company.
  • Increase employee motivation and loyalty to the company.

Hospital Network and A Cashless payment scheme.

You can receive a hospital service at the Assurances General Laos hospital network without paying money in the maximum of your coverage option.

Every insured of Assurances General Laos Health Insurance will receive a Health Card for using in the hospitals and clinics under the network for the cashless payment benefit.

  • Find out hospital network in Thailand

  • Bodily injuries
  • Loss or damage to property
  • Legal expenses incurred in your legal proceeding defense

products.description_en: Contractors' All Risks Insurance cater mainly to the protection needs of the construction industry. This policy is designed to provide protection against losses or damages in respect of the contract works at contract site and third (3rd) party claims arising in connection with the construction of a project. With additional premium, the cover may include Construction Plant and Equipment, Construction Machinery, Removal of Debris, Professional Fees and Principal’s Existing Property. Duration of cover corresponds with the contract period which is stipulated in the Letter of Award.

content.html:
Assurances General Laos

Engineering & Machinery Insurance

1. Contractors’ All Risks (CAR)

Contractors' All Risks Insurance cater mainly to the protection needs of the construction industry. This policy is designed to provide protection against losses or damages in respect of the contract works at contract site and third (3rd) party claims arising in connection with the construction of a project. With additional premium, the cover may include Construction Plant and Equipment, Construction Machinery, Removal of Debris, Professional Fees and Principal’s Existing Property. Duration of cover corresponds with the contract period which is stipulated in the Letter of Award.

2. Erection All Risks (EAR)

The Erection All Risks insurance covers all kinds of erection and testing on individual machine, industrial machinery, industrial plants, steel works and/or structure as well as third (3rd) party property and/or bodily injury arising in connection with the erection work. The cover may include Civil Engineering Works, Equipment for Erection, Removal of Debris, Professional Fees and Principal’s Existing Property. Duration of cover corresponds with the contract period which is stipulated in the Letter of Award.

3. Contractor’s Plant & Machinery (CPM)

Construction plant and machinery can be covered against all risks of accidental loss or damage whilst it is operating at construction site.

The Policy can be issued on yearly basis or depending on project period.

Assurances General Laos

1. Contractors’ All Risks (CAR)
Contractors' All Risks Insurance cater mainly to the protection needs of the construction industry. This policy is designed to provide protection against losses or damages in respect of the contract works at contract site and third (3rd) party claims arising in connection with the construction of a project. With additional premium, the cover may include Construction Plant and Equipment, Construction Machinery, Removal of Debris, Professional Fees and Principal’s Existing Property. Duration of cover corresponds with the contract period which is stipulated in the Letter of Award.
[image: https://www.agl.com.la/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/modern-building-construction-scaled.jpg]
2. Erection All Risks (EAR)
The Erection All Risks insurance covers all kinds of erection and testing on individual machine, industrial machinery, industrial plants, steel works and/or structure as well as third (3rd) party property and/or bodily injury arising in connection with the erection work. The cover may include Civil Engineering Works, Equipment for Erection, Removal of Debris, Professional Fees and Principal’s Existing Property. Duration of cover corresponds with the contract period which is stipulated in the Letter of Award.
3. Contractor’s Plant & Machinery (CPM)
Construction plant and machinery can be covered against all risks of accidental loss or damage whilst it is operating at construction site.

# The Policy can be issued on yearly basis or depending on project period.

products.description_en: Marine Cargo insurance provides coverage with options of protection against all risks or loss from accident only during the transportation of goods and merchandise – anywhere from the time your goods leave the premises of the seller until the time they arrive at the buyer’s premises

content.html:
Assurances General Laos

Transportation Insurance

1. Marine Cargo Insurance

Marine Cargo insurance provides coverage with options of protection against all risks or loss from accident only during the transportation of goods and merchandise – anywhere from the time your goods leave the premises of the seller until the time they arrive at the buyer’s premises

It covers the loss or damage to during the movement of the cargo from one port or country to another. The conveyance can be by Sea, Air or Land. Either the buyer or the seller can purchase the Marine Cargo insurance depending on your sales contract which most commonly is Free On Board (FOB), Cost and Freight (C&F) or Cost, Insurance and Freight (CIF).

2. Inland Transit Insurance

Inland Transit insurance provides coverage against loss or damage by accident

during the transportation of goods and merchandise – anywhere within Lao PDR from the time your goods leave the premises of the seller until the time they arrive at the buyer’s premises. Either the buyer or the seller can purchase this insurance.
